name: texas-flood
label: Houston Flash Flood, May 2026
notes: v1 fixture stub — Track D expands this from 12 to 50 hand-authored incidents for the judged demo. UI consumes the typed fixture in packages/fixtures during Fixture UI Preview.

incidents.raw_text: I'm trapped on my roof, water is up to my chest. I'm 67 and diabetic, I have my insulin but I'm cold and shaking.
Power is out, my baby needs formula and I can't drive out, streets are flooded around me.
Apartment fire on the second floor, lots of smoke, six families still inside, the stairwell is blocked.
